hits.title: Hazeltree appoints Trafelet as CEO - Securities Finance Times
hits.snippet: # Hazeltree appoints Trafelet as CEO 04 August 2026 US *Image: Hazeltree* Hazeltree has appointed the company’s executive chairman, Remy W. Trafelet, as chairman, president, and CEO, along with two additional senior leadership appointments. Trafelet will succeed Lokesh Seth, marking the next phase of the company's growth, expanding its treasury management, as well as its networked data and AI capabilities for alternative asset managers. Trafelet founded Hazeltree within his alternative asset management firm, Trafelet Delta Funds, prior to spinning the company out in 2011. He returned to the role of executive chairman in late 2024, renewing strategic focus on Hazeltree's treasury value proposition and data networking solutions. Prior to this, Trafelet served as managing partner at global hedge fund Trafelet Delta Funds and private investment firm Trafelet & Company, alongside a tenure as senior advisor to the US Department of the Interior. Alongside this appointment, Hazeltree has selected Jessica Segarra as the firm’s chief operating officer and Martin Koopman as chief product officer. hits.snippet: # Hazeltree appoints Remy W. Trafelet as Chief Executive Officer and makes significant additions to its leadership team *Hazeltree appoints Remy W. Trafelet as Chief Executive Officer and makes significant additions to its leadership team* **New York, London, Hong Kong - August 4, 2026** – Hazeltree, the leading provider of financial treasury management and networked data solutions to the alternative asset management industry, appointed the company’s Executive Chairman, Remy W. Trafelet, as Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Lokesh Seth. Hazeltree thanks Mr. Seth and acknowledges his significant contributions to the company during his tenure. Mr. Trafelet founded Hazeltree within his alternative asset management firm, Trafelet Delta Funds, prior to spinning the company out in 2011. In late 2024, Mr. Trafelet returned to active management at the company as Executive Chairman, leading Hazeltree’s renewed focus on the firm’s treasury value proposition and data networking capabilities. hits.snippet: August 6, 2026 · schedule2 Min Read · Hazeltree founder Remy Trafelet has taken over as chairman, president, and CEO amid a major leadership overhaul at the treasury technology provider that has also brought in Jessica Segarra as chief operating ... August 6, 2026 · schedule2 Min Read · Hazeltree founder Remy Trafelet has taken over as chairman, president, and CEO amid a major leadership overhaul at the treasury technology provider that has also brought in Jessica Segarra as chief operating officer (COO) and Martin Koopman as chief product officer. Trafelet initially created the foundation for the Hazeltree platform in 2009 as an internal project under his alternative asset management firm, Trafelet Delta Funds. The project was carved out into an independent company two years later. Trafelet returned to active company management in late 2024 as executive chairman, and helped install former DealCloud COO Lokesh Seth as CEO in January 2025. Trafelet now takes over as CEO of Hazeltree as Seth departs the company. Webinar | 24 June 2026 | What makes a Banking Tech Award winner?
